cards.card_text: They're told it was Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, the man from Timnah, because his wife was given to his companion.
cards.verse_text: “It was Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite,” they were told.
cards.snippet: “It was Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite,” they were told.
